2608.25835.title: Missing the Butterfly and Predicting the Past: Features or Bugs of Accurate AI Weather Models?
2608.25835.paper_summary: AI weather prediction (AIWP) models rival physics-based models, yet the sources of their unexpected forecast accuracy and the degree of their physical fidelity remain unclear. Here, across a hierarchy spanning observation-based reanalysis, a general circulation model, and the multi-scale Lorenz system, we show that AI models can be trained to skillfully predict the past (backcast), though backcasts are systematically less accurate than forecasts. However, skillful backcasting appears to violate the second law of thermodynamics, and all these forecasting and backcasting models miss the butterfly effect. We trace the surprising forecast accuracy, missing butterfly, and skillful backcasting to a single cause: inevitable coarse-graining of training data, which removes fast, small scales and/or some variables. From the Lorenz system to official Pangu-Weather models, reducing coarse-graining makes AI predictions more physics-like (arrow of time and butterfly-like effects emerge), but forecast accuracy declines. Results offer an explanation for AIWP models' forecast skill: unlike physics-based models, they implicitly learn how fast, small scales affect large scales without inheriting their rapid error growth. Broader implications are that AI models' proliferation calls for revisiting predictability theories and long-term climate emulation strategies, and backcasting offers a useful, new lens for such analyses.
2608.25835.paper_summary_zh: AI 天氣預測 (AIWP) 模型與基於物理的模型相媲美，但它們意外的預測準確性來源以及其物理忠實度的程度仍不清楚。<lb/>在這裡，通過一個涵蓋基於觀測的再分析、一般環流模型和多尺度洛倫茲系統的層級，我們展示了 AI 模型可以被訓練以熟練預測過去（回溯），儘管回溯的準確性系統性地低於預測。<lb/>然而，熟練的回溯似乎違反了熱力學第二定律，所有這些預測和回溯模型都忽略了蝴蝶效應。<lb/>我們將意外的預測準確性、缺失的蝴蝶和熟練的回溯追溯到一個單一原因：訓練數據的不可避免的粗粒化，這去除了快速的小尺度和/或某些變量。<lb/>從洛倫茲系統到官方的 Pangu-Weather 模型，減少粗粒化使 AI 預測更具物理特性（時間箭頭和蝴蝶效應出現），但預測準確性下降。<lb/>結果為 AIWP 模型的預測能力提供了解釋：與基於物理的模型不同，它們隱含地學習了快速的小尺度如何影響大尺度，而不會繼承其快速的誤差增長。<lb/>更廣泛的含義是，AI 模型的激增要求重新檢視可預測性理論和長期氣候模擬策略，而回溯為這類分析提供了一個有用的新視角。
